title: NBA Sim Court Zone Enum (foundation 0.4.0)
description: Authoritative closed enum of CourtZone labels. Zones are logical position labels used by events (e.g. SHOT_RELEASE.zone) and derived from continuous (x, y) poses via zoneFromPoint. The CourtZone enum itself carries no metric fields; continuous position data lives in WorldSnapshot/simulation poses per court-geometry.json. Adding or removing a zone requires a foundation_version bump per docs/foundation/README.md.

foundation_version.description: Semver stamp of the zone contract. Must match config/foundation.json#foundation_version.

items.description: Logical court zone label. Lowercase stem with optional uppercase directional suffix (_L / _R).

zones.description: The closed 14-zone CourtZone enum. minItems/maxItems pin the count; uniqueItems rejects duplicates; the per-item enum pins the exact closed set.

$comment: Pattern intentionally allows uppercase (^[a-zA-Z_]+$) because nine of the fourteen frozen zones use an uppercase directional suffix (slot_L, slot_R, wing_L, wing_R, corner_L, corner_R, elbow_L, elbow_R, dunker_L, dunker_R). This mirrors the T2 precedent: the authoritative contract (the zone strings) wins and the regex must accept it. The per-item enum is the authoritative closed set; the pattern is a redundant sanity check.
